ItemDescription.Value:
Part of [b]ModReady[/b] — the Bannerlord dependency pack. Harmony 2 runtime patcher, required by almost every mod that patches game methods. Built for Bannerlord v1.4.6. Subscribe to all four dependencies (Harmony, UIExtenderEx, ButterLib, MCM): [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198087292666/myworkshopfiles/?appid=261550]full ModReady set here[/url]. Loads through the native launcher — BLSE not required (optional, still supported). Clean-room ModReady build; credit [url=https://github.com/BUTR]BUTR[/url] for the original frameworks.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/mountandblade2bannerlord/mods/11274]Nexus — manual install, full changelog + support[/url] · [url=https://github.com/Trashpanda62/modready]GitHub — source + release zips[/url] · [url=https://www.patreon.com/Trashpanda62?utm_source=steam]Support development on Patreon[/url]
If ModReady saved you a red-screen headache, a thumbs-up helps other players find it.

ChangeNotes.Value: ModReady v1.2.0 - Updated for Bannerlord 1.4.8 mods: UIExtenderEx 3.0, MCM 5.13 and ButterLib 2.12 compatible, so mods built against the new versions load - MCM: settings a mod declares in its SubModule.xml now show in Mod Options
